mcqs.q: How many planetary boundaries did Rockstrom et al identify in 2009?
Why is the global energy transition slower than many expect?
options: The transition is slow because people don't want to give up cars.
The dependency ratio is the number of unemployed people in a country.
The energy transition is slow because renewable energy doesn't actually work.

Existing fossil-fuel infrastructure is sunk cost, low-carbon alternatives need vast capital, intermittency requires storage, and political/economic interests resist change — even as costs of renewables fall.

mcqs.q: How is the dependency ratio calculated?
options: (Population aged 0-14 plus population aged 65+) divided by population aged 15-64, multiplied by 100 — comparing dependants to the working-age population.
The dependency ratio is the number of unemployed people in a country.
The dependency ratio is the number of children per family.
The transition is slow because people don't want to give up cars.
Development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs — balancing economic, social and environmental goals.
Sustainable development means stopping all economic growth.
Sustainable development means using only solar power.
The transition is slow because people don't want to give up cars.
